summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K containing only a Statement of Executive Compensation under Canadian NI 51-102. The filing discloses compensation arrangements for named executive officers of the service provider under a Master Services Agreement; it involves no transaction, deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. This is a routine compensation disclosure, not a special situation. No price, premium, dates, advisors, or regulatory clock are present. What to watch: none, as this is purely administrative.
